Role: Informatica Developer
 Duration: 12 + months
 Location : Columbus, Ohio
 

 Job Description:
  
 ETL specialist will be responsible for:
 Administer Informatica shared services platform for a large data warehouse environment
 Maintain and monitor the Informatica platform.
 Ensuring proper configuration of the Informatica platform and identifying opportunities to tune and optimize the existing platform workload.
 Participating in the continuous improvement of key deliverables, refinement and additions to the Velocity methodology
 Review and migrate the code developed by various teams and size the environment accordingly
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
